My research interests lie in **algebraic geometry**, with particular emphasis on **toric varieties** and **Gromov–Witten theory**.

## Algebraic geometry

I am interested in geometric questions that can be studied through the interaction of algebraic, combinatorial, and intersection-theoretic methods.

## Toric varieties

Toric geometry provides a setting in which algebraic geometry interacts naturally with combinatorics. I am interested in how this structure can be used to study geometric invariants and moduli problems.

## Gromov–Witten theory

I am interested in Gromov–Witten invariants and their connections with enumerative geometry, especially in settings related to toric geometry.
